ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low (predominantly low-intensity black pixels covering ~95% of the surface with isolated high-intensity white clusters at the tips and scattered point-intensity spots).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-gray to black contiguous field across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white clusters located at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, with scattered pixel-sized white dots distributed across the central and right lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharply defined V-shaped depression with an estimated interior pixel angle of 65-75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations across the entire trailing edge. Right lobe shows more pronounced jagged peaks (amplitude 5-12 pixels) compared to the left lobe which exhibits more moderate, lower-amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve sweeping upward and outward from the peduncle base toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-intensity white pixel clusters at the far distal tips of both lobes. Several smaller, isolated circular white spots visible across the mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of white material/scarring at the distal extremities. Vertical high-intensity marks present at the insertion point where the fluke meets the peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique cluster of white spots concentrated along the lower central vertical axis of the peduncle.
